intro_npc.name: Old Mechanic
lines: Hey, kid. You're new here, aren't you?
The wasteland is unforgiving. You'll need more than just that pistol.
I've got an old tank in the back. She's seen better days, but she'll run.
If you can scrape together some parts, I'll help you fix her up.
Oh, and watch out for the Sand Worm. There's a bounty on it.
Head north to the ruins if you're feeling brave. Good hunting.

shop_npc.name: Shopkeeper
lines: Welcome to my shop. Everything's salvaged, everything's for sale.
Buy something, or get out. I don't do window shopping.

bounty_board.name: Bounty Board
lines: --- ACTIVE BOUNTIES ---
Sand Worm - 1000G - Last seen in the northern desert
Iron Titan - 5000G - Roams the eastern ruins

tank_get.name: Old Mechanic
lines: There she is. A bit rusty, but the engine still turns over.
I've installed a basic chassis and engine. The rest is up to you.
Talk to me at the garage anytime to swap parts.
Remember: heavier chassis means more defense but fewer slots.
Now get out there and earn some gold!

mayor_npc.name: Town Mayor
lines: Welcome, traveler. I am the mayor of this survivor town.
Times are hard, but we manage. Perhaps you can help us?
What would you like to know?
choices: Tell me about the bounty board

merchant_npc.name: Traveling Merchant
lines: Ah, a new face! I deal in rare goods from across the wasteland.
I've heard rumors of a hidden laboratory beneath the old ruins.
They say it holds technology from before the war...

base_commander.name: Base Commander
lines: So you found our hidden base. Impressive.
We've been monitoring the situation. The prototype mech in the lab below...
It's been killing everyone we send down there.
If you can destroy it, we'll reward you handsomely.
What do you say?
choices: Tell me more about this lab
I need more time to prepare

mountain_npc.name: Mountain Hermit
lines: Few make it this far into the mountains. You must be skilled.
The pass ahead is guarded by a Steel Golem. Be careful.
There's a toxic swamp to the east, and a hidden base further north.
Watch your step out there.

swamp_npc.name: Swamp Trader
lines: Ugh, the smell doesn't bother me anymore.
You looking to buy something? I've got supplies.
There's an ancient relic hidden somewhere in this swamp...
Find it, and it might lead you somewhere special.

lab_npc.name: Damaged Terminal
lines: ...SYSTEM ONLINE...
WARNING: Security protocols compromised.
Prototype Mech in sublevel 3... active and hostile.
...WARNING: Intruders detected. Security engaged...

base_merchant.name: Base Quartermaster
lines: Welcome to the quartermaster's desk.
We stock the finest equipment in the wasteland.
Premium weapons, armor, and tank parts. Take a look.

base_healer.name: Base Medic
lines: You look hurt. Let me patch you up.
There, good as new. Stay safe out there.

base_engineer.name: Base Engineer
lines: I keep the tanks running here at the base.
Need repairs or a refuel? I've got you covered.
Your tank is in top shape now. Come back anytime.
